STS-135, the last mission of NASA’s Space Shuttle program.
On July 8, 2011, Space Shuttle Atlantis lifted off from Kennedy Space Center, officially closing a historic 30-year era of shuttle flights.

STS-135 delivered final supplies to the International Space Station and marked the end of reusable shuttle missions.
Those camera labels you see (like UCS-15 / TV-21A) are NASA broadcast camera angles capturing this iconic moment.

Pure history. Pure emotion. 🚀🔥
